groups.trophyGroupDetail:
• Shred with over 90 master tracks that span all genres of rock including songs from bands like KISS, Muse, Soundgarden, Queen, Megadeth and more
• Build your army of Rock Warriors to save Rock ‘n Roll in all new Quest mode
• Take your skills to the next level with Quickplay + where each song has up to 13 new challenges
• Broadcast your in-game accomplishments with Hero Feed or share it with your friends on your favorite social websites
• Join the party at any time with the click of a button in Party Play
• Expand your music collection by importing your favorite on-disc and downloadable content from select previous Guitar Hero® games straight into Guitar Hero®: Warriors of Rock and enjoy these songs with additional challenges in Quickplay+ *Does not apply to a limited number of songs

groups.name: Call of Duty®: Black Ops
groups.trophyGroupDetail:
Call of Duty®: Black Ops takes you deep behind enemy lines into the world of deniable operations as a member of an elite special forces unit engaging in covert warfare, classified operations, and explosive conflicts across the globe. With access to a variety of exclusive weaponry and equipment, your actions will tip the balance during the most dangerous time period mankind has ever known.  
Black Ops features:
 - An epic campaign and a story that keeps you glued to the edge of your seat from start to finish.
 - Call of Duty's signature Multiplayer gameplay with deeper levels of character customization, and all new modes like Wager Matches, the Theater, and Combat Training which can be played Solo or Co-Op. 
 - Zombies! Providing endless hours of intense Zombie-slaying entertainment, Solo or Co-Op.

groups.trophyGroupDetail: Call of Duty: Black Ops 3 deploys its players into a future where bio-technology has enabled a new breed of Black Ops soldier. Players are now always on and always connected to the intelligence grid and their fellow operatives during battle. In a world more divided than ever, this elite squad consists of men and women who have enhanced their combat capabilities to fight faster, stronger, and smarter. Every soldier has to make difficult decisions and visit dark places in this engaging, gritty narrative.
